title: Khusela verdict
description: Response of POST /check and return value of engine.evaluate(). Synthetic data only.

check_id.description: Unique id of this check, e.g. chk_000123

verdict.description: Decided by the Python rules only. Never by the AI.

reasons.description: Why the verdict was reached. Empty array for MATCH.

explanation.description: Two plain-English sentences for the seller. Always ends with the bank reminder idea.

extracted.description: What OCR read from the screenshot. A field is null when OCR could not find it.

expected.description: The sale the seller entered, plus the registered business name.

same_seller.description: true when the earlier image came from the same seller

raw_ocr_text.description: Shown next to the verdict so the seller can check it by eye.

bank_reminder.const: Confirm the money in your banking app before you release goods.
